title: Nanjing Massacre
summary: After taking Nanjing, the Imperial Japanese Army carried out mass murder and rape. Newer estimates put the dead at 100,000-200,000 (others range from 40,000 to over 340,000); about 20,000 rapes is the most common estimate.
why: Still contested in Sino-Japanese relations; some Japanese nationalists and officials have denied or minimised it.
